authority_rank_context.POWO_WCVP: Panicum coloratum L. accepted species; one homotypic Milium combination and ten heterotypic synonyms; var. makarikariense synonymized under accepted species.
authority_rank_context.specialist_forages: Tropical Forages continues to describe var. coloratum and var. makarikariense for agronomic morphology and cultivar grouping; this does not establish accepted infraspecific POWO taxa.
authority_rank_context.homonym: Panicum coloratum Walter (1788) is an illegitimate later homonym mapped to accepted Panicum virgatum L., NOT Panicum coloratum L. (1767).

handoff: Keep existing P. coloratum L. kleingrass learner card. No duplicate var. makarikariense card under POWO. Source-labelled Australian variety anatomy may remain labelled by its original source, but cannot certify Texas source specimen, variety, cultivar or hybrid ancestry. Do not confuse Panicum coloratum Walter with kleingrass; it is a later homonym mapped to switchgrass.
